'Reimagined IP' announcements travel: Great Gatsby police procedural 1.65M (top post), Coco in Fortnite 935k, Pikmin animated short 377k, Princess and the Frog special 308k and 150k
Primetime keeps building: scrapped opening credits 1.11M, Robert Pattinson's surprise London screening 156k

narrative_synthesis: A quieter day after the Patrick Stewart news. DiscussingFilm's Great Gatsby cop-show announcement topped the watchlist at 1.65M, just ahead of the surprise Halloween 'IT: Welcome to Derry' episode at 1.62M. Franchise first looks (Avengers: Doomsday promo 1.32M, Hunger Games first clip 1.28M) and Primetime's scrapped credits (1.11M) filled out the top. RealEmirHan posted no originals in the window.
